args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 18%, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled_out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — across all regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out` (v2.3.0 now live in us-east, us-west, and eu-west).

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback action, which paged the on-call engineer for follow-up on root cause.

Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging, which suggests the regression was present before production — worth including in the incident investigation.
